step1_analysis.description: A single-ended to differential pre-amplifier used in the front-end of a Capacitance-to-Digital Converter. It uses a folded cascode architecture with diode-connected loads to provide a low-impedance, wideband signal (VON) and a reference voltage (VOP) for subsequent stages.

paper_reference.title: A Capacitance-to-Digital Converter for Displacement Sensing with 17b Resolution and 20μs Conversion Time

DC_Power.description: Total DC power consumption of the pre-amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current is dominated by the tail current source (XM9/XM16) and the cascode bias branches. Assuming ~40uA per branch and 3 main branches, total current is ~120uA. Power = 1.8V * 120uA = 216uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and typical bias currents for W/L=5u/0.5u.

AC_Gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from VIP to VON.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * R_load. The load consists of diode-connected transistors (XM10, XM3), so R_load ≈ 1/(gm_p + gm_n). Since input and load transistors have similar dimensions, gain is roughly gm_in / (2*gm_load) ≈ 0.5 V/V or -6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected loads inherently limit the voltage gain to low values, acting primarily as a transimpedance or current-mode stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * π * R_load * C_load). With R_load ≈ 2.5 kΩ and C_load = 50 fF, BW ≈ 1.2 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The low impedance of the diode-connected loads pushes the dominant pole to very high frequencies.

Transient_Swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing at VON for a 0.2V input step.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the low AC gain of the stage.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient response of the pre-amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pre-amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u

XM1 VB3 N_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_FOLD1 N_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VON VON N_FOLD1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N_FOLD2 VB3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_FOLD1 VB3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N_CMFB VCM N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N_CASC_P1 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N_CMFB N_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VON VON N_CASC_P1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N_CMFB N_CMFB GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 VB3 N_CMFB N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N_FOLD1 VIP N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 VOP VOP N_FOLD2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N_CASC_P2 VB1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N_TAIL VB2 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N_CMFB VCM N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 VOP VOP N_CASC_P2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB3 VB3 0 0.54
VVCM VCM 0 0.9
VVB1 VB1 0 0.99
VVB2 VB2 0 0.99

* Input Signal (DC=0.9V, AC=1V, Pulse for Tran)
VVIP VIP 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.8 1.0 1n 1n 1n 5u 10u)

* Load Capacitors
C1 VON 0 50f
C2 VOP 0 50f

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(VON) v(VOP)

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VON)
meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=$&gain_3db fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 10n 20u
meas tran v_out_max max v(VON)
meas tran v_out_min min v(VON)
let v_out_pp = v_out_max - v_out_min
print v_out_pp

quit
.endc
.end
